lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Mister,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: don't tell me you forgot?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: The promise we made at the bar.
What promise?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Sigh... I knew this would happen.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Last time we ran into each other at the bar,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: a certain someone promised we'd go swimming.
The only thing I recall is drinking a whole bunch.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: It was kinda cute, actually.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: To be fair, I expected you not to remember

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: since you were three sheets to the wind.
Is today the day we're supposed to hang out?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I already booked the swimming pool.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Apparently, I'm the only one who remembered.
Sorry, I'll head over there right now.
Can I come a bit later?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: That's more like it!

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I want us to make the most of our time together,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: so I have my men stand guard around the perimeter.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: You don't have to worry about anyone disturbing us.
Is that really necessary?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: It's for anyone who might dare to bother us.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: If someone barges in on our private time, I might not be able to hold back.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Fine. Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: If you're late, I won't wait for you.
Is there anything that I should bring?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Just bring that body of yours.
Come again?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Just bring yourself.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I've already prepared everything that we'll need.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I wouldn't want my man inconvenienced in any way.
... We're just going swimming, right?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: What's this, Mister?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I won't bite.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: If you feel tired, you can take a nap in the room I booked for us.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Unless...

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: you have something else in mind.
No. I'll be right there.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: come fully prepared.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: We're going to have a blast, so get ready to enjoy yourself.
